change_summary: Preserved the tl.maximum and tl.minimum clamps before libdevice.tanh because the reference computes tanh(clamp(x,-1,1)) which differs from tanh(x) for large |x| (swish(x)/2 → x/2 as x→∞), making the clamp mathematically necessary for correctness.
